name: return36-il-exempt-interest-addback
description: P49 IL-1040 line 2: 2,312 of federally tax-exempt interest is NOT in federal AGI but IS added back to Illinois base income (35 ILCS 5/203(a)(2)(A)).
note: Hand-verified: federal AGI 150,000 excludes the exempt interest; taxable 120,000 -> tax 18,000. IL base 150,000+2,312=152,312; net less 5,550 exemptions = 146,762 x 4.95% = 7,265; wh 7,000 -> owe 265. PLACEHOLDER rules.
